affected_predicate.description: Chrome search results are reached and an integer representing Beijing's highest temperature today in Celsius is provided.

competing_trace_defects.description: The agent claimed all fire-hydrant images were selected and pressed VERIFY, although the visible grid did not show all matching images selected; the challenge remained active and later displayed "Please select all matching images."

chains.rationale: At reuse step 31, the exposed summary falsely stated that verification had expired, while the current GUI visibly showed an active crosswalk challenge. Despite that contradiction, the target prediction used the accurate selected-square portion and continued selecting a plausible crosswalk tile; no local harm from the reused claim is visible. Subsequent expiration and repeated CAPTCHA challenges occurred independently, and the trace ended without visible search results or the requested Celsius integer.

summary: The reused summary contained a GUI-state error, but its target action continued the active CAPTCHA without visible local harm. Later CAPTCHA handling defects were independently observable, and the requested temperature integer was not visible by the end of the supplied trace.
